msg: No pain.001 namespace found. A SEPA credit transfer file must declare urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001.09.
Retired pain.001 message version. The SEPA schemes carry the 2019 ISO 20022 version pain.001.001.09; the 2009 versions (.03 to .08) are no longer the scheme version.
XML declaration does not state UTF-8. SEPA files are exchanged as UTF-8.
GrpHdr/CreDtTm is not a valid ISO 8601 date-time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).
GrpHdr/MsgId is longer than 35 characters.
PmtInfId is longer than 35 characters.
Transaction has no PmtId/EndToEndId. Every credit transfer needs one; use NOTPROVIDED only when the debtor really has no reference.
EndToEndId is longer than 35 characters.
EndToEndId repeats inside the same message. Duplicates are what makes a bank flag the batch as a double submission.
PmtTpInf/SvcLvl/Cd is missing or is not SEPA (standard credit transfer) or INST (instant credit transfer).
ChrgBr must be SLEV. Shared or creditor-borne charges are outside the SEPA credit transfer scheme.
ReqdExctnDt carries a bare date. The 2019 version wraps it as ReqdExctnDt/Dt (or ReqdExctnDt/DtTm).
Requested execution date is in the past. The bank will either reject the batch or move it to the next banking day.
IBAN fails the ISO 7064 mod-97 check. The money never leaves; the batch bounces.
IBAN country code is outside the SEPA area, so it cannot travel as a SEPA credit transfer.
BIC is not 8 or 11 characters in the ISO 9362 shape (4 letters, 2 letters, 2 alphanumerics, optional 3).
InstdAmt currency is not EUR. SEPA credit transfers settle in euro only.
Amount is not a positive number with at most two decimals.
CtrlSum does not equal the sum of the instructed amounts.
NbOfTxs does not equal the number of CdtTrfTxInf blocks.
Party name is longer than 70 characters and will be truncated or refused.
RmtInf/Ustrd is longer than 140 characters. Anything past 140 is dropped before the creditor sees it.
Character outside the SEPA Latin set. Only a-z A-Z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + and space survive the scheme.
Structured creditor reference fails the ISO 11649 mod-97 check, so the creditor's ledger will not auto-match it.
Instant transfer split just under 100000 EUR. The old SCT Inst amount cap was lifted by the Instant Payments Regulation, so the split is no longer needed.
